narration.text: The DFIR triage analysis of the collection_s1_v3 identified 132 anomalies across various executables and files. The anomaly scorer, moda_g, ranked the anomalies based on their percentile in their respective families. The top anomalies included "dllhost.exe" and "onedrivesetup.exe" with a percentile of 0.0, and "runtimebroker.exe" with a percentile of 0.0986. The anomaly layer detected rules such as R-ATOMIC-0002, R-ATOMIC-0006, and R-CORR-0001. The top anomalies were primarily associated with the prefetch and amcache families. The collection also contained a large number of suspicious files, including various PDFs, executables, and compressed files, which were ranked by moda_g.
